headline: US weighs forcing nations to pick its AI bloc or China's
body: A busy day with eight stories; the biggest was geopolitical. Reuters reported Washington may warn dozens of countries that joining Beijing's AI framework would shut them out of a US-led coalition. Splitting the world into rival blocs weakens Global Coordination, which lifts Self-Destruction and drags down Gatekeeper, the ending that needs nations working together. Reports that China is slowing critical-material exports to Taiwan added to Catastrophic Risk. On the brighter side, Claude-designed proteins hit 14 of 15 targets and Unitree's huge IPO pushed Capability Velocity, OpenAI piloted a privacy-preserving abuse monitor, and Pew found most Americans more worried than excited about AI. Horizon Balance held at -4.22; Self-Destruction moved above Libertarian Utopia.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.5 from the US bloc ultimatum (+0.32) and China's Taiwan export curbs (+0.26); Gatekeeper -0.3 and 1984 -0.4 from the bloc story (-0.45 and -0.26) after offsets.
